<b>Plasmium</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Three samples of Plasmium are required to complete the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> [[wish]], given by [[Alchemist Zylotol]] in the [[Wormways]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Alchemist Zylotol 01.png!Location of Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Wormways 04.png!Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
}}

{{Clear}}

== How to Acquire ==
Plasmium can be extracted from [[Plasmium Bud|Plasmium buds]] during the <i>Alchemist's Assistant</i> wish with a fully charged stab from the [[Needle Phial]]. Three of these buds can be found throughout the Wormways, detectable through walls by their extremely deep blue glow.
